store_reviews.title: Porsche Panamera
store_reviews.body: Five weeks sounded like forever when I placed the order. Then the Panamera rolled out on those black multi-spokes and, yeah, I stopped checking the calendar. The bright lip catches just enough light without turning the car into a showpiece.

store_reviews.title: Mercedes-Benz GLS
store_reviews.body: The GLS is a big SUV, so I wanted a wheel that would not get lost under it. These polished spokes have real presence. The finish looks consistent up close, like a proper big-shop job. It came out remarkably close to the design I signed off on.

store_reviews.title: NIO
store_reviews.body: I sent over a pretty specific silver split-spoke reference and was a little worried it might look too busy on the green car. Once the set went on, the whole side profile just clicked. The final look is right in line with the design we discussed.

store_reviews.title: SUV wheel installation
store_reviews.body: I was after something cleaner than another skinny-spoke setup. That broad silver face against the black openings gives the SUV a completely different vibe, especially from the side. It feels custom without screaming for attention.

store_reviews.title: Audi wheel installation
store_reviews.body: For the Audi, I wanted a smooth, almost architectural face. Seeing that style mounted on the car is what sold me. It changes the look without piling on visual noise. I would pick the same finish again.

store_reviews.title: Audi wheel installation
store_reviews.body: Not gonna lie, I hesitated because CIRUI was new to me. I used AI to sort out the fitment and finish questions I should ask, then talked through the options. The silver wheels against that deep burgundy paint came out sharp.

store_reviews.title: Mercedes-Benz G-Class
store_reviews.body: On a G-Class, I did not want another loud off-road-looking wheel. The dark face with that thin bright edge was exactly the direction I had in mind. From a distance it is simple; up close, the details do the work.

store_reviews.title: Land Rover Defender
store_reviews.body: The Defender already has plenty of character. I asked for a straightforward black five-spoke that would work with the truck, not fight it. Mounted up, it looks like it belongs there. That was the whole point.

store_reviews.title: Porsche SUV
store_reviews.body: I kept the color simple and let the spoke pattern do the work. The silver finish looks great next to the red calipers on the Porsche SUV. It is a clean upgrade, and I like that it still feels at home on the car.
